provenance.derivation: The joint W/L demand graph forces generic finite indexing/cardinality and recursive/fold structures. Core K7 requires but does not itself supply well-founded/inductive carrier authority.

items.body: A constructor signature Sigma is a finite indexed family of constructor tags. Each tag has a finite ordered field list; each field is declared either recursive into the generated carrier or external into a separately declared raw carrier.
Given Sigma, the generated carrier Mu(Sigma) contains all and only finite well-founded constructor trees formed from the tags and fields of Sigma; no other members are admitted.
Different constructor tags produce distinct members of Mu(Sigma). For one constructor tag, two constructed members are equal exactly when every corresponding ordered field value is equal.
For any property P on Mu(Sigma), if every constructor case preserves P assuming P for each recursive field, then P holds for every member of Mu(Sigma).

For any target carrier A and one target constructor-function for each Sigma constructor, there exists exactly one fold map fold:Mu(Sigma)->A whose value on a constructed member is the corresponding target constructor-function applied to the folded recursive fields and unchanged external fields.
No member of Mu(Sigma) has an infinite descending chain through recursive fields; every member has finite constructor depth, and recursive definitions may recurse only through recursive fields.

DNWF supplies only generic well-founded constructor, induction, and fold authority. It supplies no arithmetic, ordering, algebra, topology, geometry, physics, source-domain object, or source-specific theorem.

anti_scope: No Woit or Lisi source object appears in DNWF semantics.
No arithmetic operation is primitive DNWF authority.
DNWF may not be consumed by W, L, or DNIA until independently qualified.
required_qualification: Q0 source freeze and interpretation closure
Q2 native/schema closure and parse integrity
Q3 two independent fresh cold reconstructions
